i.norm: Verifies that a {@link NodeIterator} can be restarted from a new node and then resumes iterating in document order from that node onward.
A fresh iterator walks the whole document, in document order.
After restarting at the second div, the same iterator walks only that subtree.

Drains the iterator and asserts that the nodes it produces, summarised one per node, match the expected semicolon-separated string. Also checks that every node is non-null and that no node is returned twice in a row.

Appends a short, human-readable summary of {@code node} (followed by a ';') to {@code out}: an element as its tag name (plus "#id" when it has an id), a text node as its text, and any other node as its node name.
